title: %extract - pull a regex capture group
purpose: Return a capture group from the first regex match in a string.
notes: Two required arguments plus an optional group index (default 0 = whole match, 1 = first capture group).
Returns null when the pattern does not match or the group index is out of range.

avoid.why: quoting the first argument as "text" matches against the literal word, which has no digits, so the result is null (~); use @.text to read the field
